12	# Carousel
13	
14	`Carousel` presents a sequence of slides with previous/next buttons, dot indicators, keyboard arrow keys, touch/pointer swipe with momentum, and optional auto-play. Supports looping navigation, fractional slides-per-view, configurable alignment, and full WAI-ARIA carousel pattern compliance.
15	
16	## 1. State Machine

26	    /// Auto-play timer is running.
27	    AutoPlaying,
28	    /// A slide transition animation is in progress.
29	    Transitioning,
30	}

91	    /// Whether manual interaction permanently stops auto-play.
92	    pub stop_on_interaction: bool,
93	    /// Whether keyboard focus within the carousel pauses auto-play.
94	    pub pause_on_focus: bool,

96	    pub pause_on_hover: bool,
97	}
98	
99	impl Default for AutoPlayOptions {
100	    fn default() -> Self {
101	        AutoPlayOptions {
102	            interval: Duration::from_millis(4000),
103	            stop_on_interaction: true,
104	            pause_on_focus: true,
105	            pause_on_hover: true,
106	        }

109	
110	/// Runtime context for the Carousel state machine.
111	#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
112	pub struct Context {
113	    /// Current slide index (controlled/uncontrolled).
114	    pub index: Bindable<usize>,
115	    /// Total number of slides.
116	    pub slide_count: NonZero<usize>,
117	    /// Whether navigation wraps around.
118	    pub loop_nav: bool,
119	    /// Auto-play configuration. `None` disables auto-play.
120	    pub auto_play: Option<AutoPlayOptions>,
121	    /// Whether auto-play has been permanently stopped by user interaction.
122	    pub auto_play_stopped: bool,
123	    /// Whether auto-play is temporarily paused (hover/focus).
124	    pub auto_play_paused: bool,
125	    /// Gap between slides in pixels.
126	    pub spacing: f64,
127	    /// Number of slides visible at once (fractional supported).
128	    pub slides_per_view: f64,
129	    /// Number of slides to advance per navigation action. Defaults to `1`.
130	    /// When `slides_per_view > 1`, setting this to match `slides_per_view`
131	    /// provides page-by-page navigation.
132	    pub slides_per_move: usize,
133	    /// Slide alignment within the viewport.
134	    pub align: SlideAlignment,
135	    /// Slide axis.
136	    pub orientation: Orientation,
137	    /// CSS transition duration for slide animations.
138	    pub transition_duration: Duration,
139	    /// Pointer position at drag start. `None` when not dragging.
140	    pub drag_start_pos: Option<f64>,
141	    /// Accumulated drag distance in pixels.
142	    pub drag_delta: f64,
143	    /// Distance threshold (pixels) to trigger a swipe navigation.
144	    pub swipe_threshold: f64,
145	    /// Time-normalized swipe velocity (px/ms). Independent of display refresh rate.
146	    pub swipe_velocity: f64,
147	    /// Timestamp of the last PointerMove event (ms, from `performance.now()`).
148	    pub drag_last_timestamp: Option<f64>,
149	    /// Whether the carousel is right-to-left.
150	    pub is_rtl: bool,
151	    /// Resolved locale for MessageFn calls.
152	    pub locale: Locale,
153	    /// Resolved translatable messages.
154	    pub messages: Messages,
155	    /// Component IDs.
156	    pub ids: ComponentIds,
157	}
158	
159	impl Context {
160	    pub fn current_index(&self) -> usize { *self.index.get() }
161	
162	    /// Clamp or wrap an index according to `loop_nav`.
163	    pub fn clamp_index(&self, i: isize) -> usize {
164	        let n = self.slide_count.get() as isize;
165	        if self.loop_nav {
166	            ((i % n) + n) as usize % self.slide_count.get()
167	        } else {
168	            (i.max(0) as usize).min(self.slide_count.get().saturating_sub(1))
169	        }
170	    }
171	
172	    pub fn can_go_prev(&self) -> bool { self.loop_nav || self.current_index() > 0 }
173	    pub fn can_go_next(&self) -> bool { self.loop_nav || self.current_index() + 1 < self.slide_count.get() }
174	
175	    /// CSS translate percentage for the slide track.
176	    pub fn track_offset_percent(&self, viewport_width: f64) -> f64 {
177	        let idx = self.current_index() as f64;
178	        let per_slide = 100.0 / self.slides_per_view;
179	        let drag_correction = if viewport_width > 0.0 {
180	            (self.drag_delta / viewport_width) * 100.0
181	        } else {
182	            0.0
183	        };
184	        -(idx * per_slide) + drag_correction
185	    }
186	}

246	### 1.5 Full Machine Implementation
247	
248	```rust
249	pub struct Machine;
250	
251	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
252	    type State = State;
253	    type Event = Event;
254	    type Context = Context;
255	    type Props = Props;
256	    type Messages = Messages;
257	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
258	
259	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
260	        let initial_state = if props.auto_play.is_some() {
261	            State::AutoPlaying
262	        } else {
263	            State::Idle
264	        };
265	        let initial_index = props.default_index.unwrap_or(0);
266	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
267	        let messages = messages.clone();
268	        let ctx = Context {
269	            index: props.index.clone()
270	                .unwrap_or_else(|| Bindable::uncontrolled(initial_index)),
271	            slide_count: props.slide_count,
272	            loop_nav: props.loop_nav,
273	            auto_play: props.auto_play.clone(),
274	            auto_play_stopped: false,
275	            auto_play_paused: false,
276	            spacing: props.spacing.unwrap_or(0.0),
277	            slides_per_view: props.slides_per_view.unwrap_or(1.0),
278	            slides_per_move: props.slides_per_move.unwrap_or(1),
279	            align: props.align.unwrap_or_default(),
280	            orientation: props.orientation.unwrap_or_default(),
281	            is_rtl: props.is_rtl,
282	            transition_duration: props.transition_duration
283	                .unwrap_or_else(|| Duration::from_millis(300)),
284	            drag_start_pos: None,
285	            drag_delta: 0.0,
286	            swipe_threshold: props.swipe_threshold.unwrap_or(50.0),
287	            swipe_velocity: 0.0,
288	            drag_last_timestamp: None,
289	            locale,
290	            messages,
291	            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),
292	        };
293	        (initial_state, ctx)
294	    }
295	
296	    fn transition(
297	        state: &Self::State,
298	        event: &Self::Event,
299	        ctx: &Self::Context,
300	        props: &Self::Props,
301	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
302	        match event {
303	            Event::GoToSlide { index } => {
304	                if *state == State::Transitioning { return None; }
305	                let idx = *index;
306	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Transitioning).apply(move |ctx| {
307	                    ctx.index.set(idx);
308	                }))
309	            }
310	
311	            Event::GoToNext => {
312	                if *state == State::Transitioning || !ctx.can_go_next() { return None; }
313	                let step = ctx.slides_per_move as isize;
314	                let next = ctx.clamp_index(ctx.current_index() as isize + step);
315	                let stop = ctx.auto_play.as_ref().map_or(false, |o| o.stop_on_interaction);
316	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Transitioning).apply(move |ctx| {
317	                    ctx.index.set(next);
318	                    if stop { ctx.auto_play_stopped = true; }
319	                }))
320	            }
321	
322	            Event::GoToPrev => {
323	                if *state == State::Transitioning || !ctx.can_go_prev() { return None; }
324	                let step = ctx.slides_per_move as isize;
325	                let prev = ctx.clamp_index(ctx.current_index() as isize - step);
326	                let stop = ctx.auto_play.as_ref().map_or(false, |o| o.stop_on_interaction);
327	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Transitioning).apply(move |ctx| {
328	                    ctx.index.set(prev);
329	                    if stop { ctx.auto_play_stopped = true; }
330	                }))
331	            }
332	
333	            Event::TransitionEnd => {
334	                if ctx.auto_play.is_some() && !ctx.auto_play_stopped && !ctx.auto_play_paused {
335	                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::AutoPlaying))
336	                } else {
337	                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle))
338	                }
339	            }
340	
341	            Event::AutoPlayStart => {
342	                if ctx.auto_play_stopped || ctx.auto_play.is_none() { return None; }
343	                let interval = ctx.auto_play.as_ref()?.interval;
344	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::AutoPlaying).with_named_effect(
345	                    "auto-play",
346	                    move |_ctx, _props, send| {
347	                        let handle = set_interval(move || send(Event::AutoPlayTick), interval);
348	                        Box::new(move || clear_interval(handle))
349	                    },
350	                ))
351	            }
352	
353	            Event::AutoPlayStop => {
354	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(|ctx| {
355	                    ctx.auto_play_stopped = true;
356	                }).cancel_effect("auto-play"))
357	            }
358	
359	            Event::AutoPlayTick => {
360	                if *state != State::AutoPlaying { return None; }
361	                let step = ctx.slides_per_move as isize;
362	                let next = ctx.clamp_index(ctx.current_index() as isize + step);
363	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Transitioning).apply(move |ctx| {
364	                    ctx.index.set(next);
365	                }))
366	            }
367	
368	            Event::AutoPlayPause => {
369	                let plan = if *state == State::AutoPlaying {
370	                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle)
371	                } else {
372	                    TransitionPlan::new()
373	                };
374	                Some(plan.apply(|ctx| { ctx.auto_play_paused = true; }).cancel_effect("auto-play"))
375	            }
376	
377	            Event::AutoPlayResume => {
378	                if ctx.auto_play_stopped { return None; }
379	                if let Some(ref opts) = ctx.auto_play {
380	                    let interval = opts.interval;
381	                    return Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::AutoPlaying).apply(|ctx| {
382	                        ctx.auto_play_paused = false;
383	                    }).with_named_effect("auto-play", move |_ctx, _props, send| {
384	                        let handle = set_interval(move || send(Event::AutoPlayTick), interval);
385	                        Box::new(move || clear_interval(handle))
386	                    }));
387	                }
388	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| { ctx.auto_play_paused = false; }))
389	            }
390	
391	            Event::PointerDown { pos, timestamp } => {
392	                let p = *pos;
393	                let ts = *timestamp;
394	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
395	                    ctx.drag_start_pos = Some(p);
396	                    ctx.drag_delta = 0.0;
397	                    ctx.swipe_velocity = 0.0;
398	                    ctx.drag_last_timestamp = Some(ts);
399	                }).cancel_effect("auto-play"))
400	            }
401	
402	            Event::PointerMove { pos, timestamp } => {
403	                if ctx.drag_start_pos.is_none() { return None; }
404	                let p = *pos;
405	                let ts = *timestamp;
406	                let start = ctx.drag_start_pos?;
407	                let prev_delta = ctx.drag_delta;
408	                let prev_ts = ctx.drag_last_timestamp;
409	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
410	                    ctx.drag_delta = p - start;
411	                    let pixel_delta = ctx.drag_delta - prev_delta;
412	                    let dt = prev_ts.map_or(0.0, |t| ts - t);
413	                    ctx.swipe_velocity = if dt > 0.0 { pixel_delta / dt } else { 0.0 };
414	                    ctx.drag_last_timestamp = Some(ts);
415	                }))
416	            }
417	
418	            Event::PointerUp => {
419	                let delta = ctx.drag_delta;
420	                let velocity = ctx.swipe_velocity;
421	                let threshold = ctx.swipe_threshold;
422	                // A brisk flick (>0.5 px/ms) reduces the distance threshold.
423	                let effective = if velocity.abs() > 0.5 { threshold * 0.3 } else { threshold };
424	
425	                let cur = ctx.current_index() as isize;
426	                let next_idx = if delta < -effective && ctx.can_go_next() {
427	                    Some(ctx.clamp_index(cur + 1))
428	                } else if delta > effective && ctx.can_go_prev() {
429	                    Some(ctx.clamp_index(cur - 1))
430	                } else {
431	                    None
432	                };
433	
434	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(move |ctx| {
435	                    ctx.drag_start_pos = None;
436	                    ctx.drag_delta = 0.0;
437	                    ctx.swipe_velocity = 0.0;
438	                    ctx.drag_last_timestamp = None;
439	                    if let Some(idx) = next_idx {
440	                        ctx.index.set(idx);
441	                    }
442	                }))
443	            }
444	
445	            Event::PointerCancel => {
446	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
447	                    ctx.drag_start_pos = None;
448	                    ctx.drag_delta = 0.0;
449	                    ctx.swipe_velocity = 0.0;
450	                    ctx.drag_last_timestamp = None;
451	                }))
452	            }
453	
454	            Event::FocusSlide { index } => {
455	                let idx = *index;
456	                let current = ctx.current_index();
457	                let should_pause = ctx.auto_play.as_ref().map_or(false, |o| o.pause_on_focus);
458	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
459	                    if idx != current { ctx.index.set(idx); }
460	                    if should_pause { ctx.auto_play_paused = true; }
461	                }))
462	            }
463	
464	            Event::Blur => {
465	                if ctx.auto_play_paused && !ctx.auto_play_stopped {
466	                    if let Some(ref opts) = ctx.auto_play {
467	                        let interval = opts.interval;
468	                        return Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::AutoPlaying).apply(|ctx| {
469	                            ctx.auto_play_paused = false;
470	                        }).with_named_effect("auto-play", move |_ctx, _props, send| {
471	                            let handle = set_interval(move || send(Event::AutoPlayTick), interval);
472	                            Box::new(move || clear_interval(handle))
473	                        }));
474	                    }
475	                }
476	                None
477	            }
478	        }
479	    }
480	
481	    fn connect<'a>(
482	        state: &'a Self::State,
483	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
484	        props: &'a Self::Props,
485	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
486	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
487	        Api { state, ctx, props, send }
488	    }
489	}
490	```

495	#[derive(ComponentPart)]

519	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {

522	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
523	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);

527	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-state"), match self.state {
528	            State::Idle => "idle",
529	            State::AutoPlaying => "auto-playing",
530	            State::Transitioning => "transitioning",
531	        });
532	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-orientation"), match self.ctx.orientation {
533	            Orientation::Horizontal => "horizontal",

535	        });

539	    pub fn viewport_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {

541	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Viewport.data_attrs();
542	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
543	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);

558	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);

568	    pub fn item_attrs(&self, index: usize) -> AttrMap {

583	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Inert, true);

664	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::ProgressText.data_attrs();
665	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
666	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
667	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Live), "polite");
668	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Atomic), "true");
669	        attrs

671	
672	    /// Human-readable progress string (e.g., "Slide 2 of 5").
673	    pub fn progress_text(&self) -> String {
674	        (self.ctx.messages.slide_label)(
675	            self.ctx.current_index() + 1,
676	            self.ctx.slide_count.get(),
677	            &self.ctx.locale,
678	        )
679	    }
680	
681	    pub fn on_root_keydown(&self, data: &KeyboardEventData) {
682	        let is_horizontal = self.ctx.orientation == Orientation::Horizontal;
683	        let (prev_key, next_key) = if is_horizontal {
684	            if self.ctx.is_rtl {
685	                (KeyboardKey::ArrowRight, KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft)
686	            } else {
687	                (KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft, KeyboardKey::ArrowRight)
688	            }
689	        } else {
690	            (KeyboardKey::ArrowUp, KeyboardKey::ArrowDown)
691	        };
692	        match data.key {
693	            k if k == prev_key => (self.send)(Event::GoToPrev),
694	            k if k == next_key => (self.send)(Event::GoToNext),
695	            KeyboardKey::Home => (self.send)(Event::GoToSlide { index: 0 }),
696	            KeyboardKey::End => (self.send)(Event::GoToSlide {
697	                index: self.ctx.slide_count.get().saturating_sub(1),
698	            }),
699	            _ => {}
700	        }
701	    }
702	
703	    pub fn on_prev_trigger_click(&self) { (self.send)(Event::GoToPrev); }
704	    pub fn on_next_trigger_click(&self) { (self.send)(Event::GoToNext); }
705	    pub fn on_indicator_click(&self, index: usize) { (self.send)(Event::GoToSlide { index }); }
706	    pub fn on_auto_play_trigger_click(&self) {
707	        if self.ctx.auto_play_stopped || self.ctx.auto_play_paused {
708	            (self.send)(Event::AutoPlayResume);
709	        } else {
710	            (self.send)(Event::AutoPlayPause);
711	        }
712	    }
713	    pub fn on_viewport_pointerdown(&self, pos: f64, timestamp: f64) {
714	        (self.send)(Event::PointerDown { pos, timestamp });
715	    }
716	    pub fn on_viewport_pointermove(&self, pos: f64, timestamp: f64) {
717	        (self.send)(Event::PointerMove { pos, timestamp });
718	    }
719	    pub fn on_viewport_pointerup(&self) { (self.send)(Event::PointerUp); }
720	}

728	            Part::Viewport => self.viewport_attrs(),

730	            Part::Item { index } => self.item_attrs(index),

734	            Part::Indicator { index } => self.indicator_attrs(index),
735	            Part::AutoPlayTrigger => self.auto_play_trigger_attrs(),
736	            Part::AutoPlayIndicator => self.autoplay_indicator_attrs(),
737	            Part::ProgressText => self.progress_text_attrs(),
738	        }
739	    }

743	## 2. Anatomy
744	
745	```text
746	Carousel
747	├── Root              <section>  role="region" aria-roledescription="carousel"
748	│   ├── PrevTrigger   <button>   "Previous slide"
749	│   ├── Viewport      <div>      overflow:hidden, touch-action
750	│   │   └── ItemGroup <div>      aria-live="off|polite"
751	│   │       └── Item  (×N) <div> role="group" aria-roledescription="slide"
752	│   ├── NextTrigger   <button>   "Next slide"
753	│   ├── IndicatorGroup <div>     role="tablist"
754	│   │   └── Indicator (×N) <button> role="tab" aria-selected
755	│   ├── AutoPlayTrigger <button> aria-pressed
756	│   ├── AutoPlayIndicator <div> aria-hidden="true" data-ars-state
757	│   └── ProgressText <div>  aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"
758	```
759	
760	| Part              | Element     | Key Attributes                                          |
761	| ----------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
762	| Root              | `<section>` | `role="region"`, `aria-roledescription="carousel"`      |
763	| Viewport          | `<div>`     | `overflow:hidden`, `touch-action`                       |
764	| ItemGroup         | `<div>`     | `aria-live="off\|polite"`                               |
765	| Item              | `<div>`     | `role="group"`, `aria-roledescription="slide"`, `inert` |
766	| PrevTrigger       | `<button>`  | `aria-disabled` when at boundary                        |
767	| NextTrigger       | `<button>`  | `aria-disabled` when at boundary                        |
768	| IndicatorGroup    | `<div>`     | `role="tablist"`                                        |
769	| Indicator         | `<button>`  | `role="tab"`, `aria-selected`                           |
770	| AutoPlayTrigger   | `<button>`  | `aria-pressed`                                          |
771	| AutoPlayIndicator | `<div>`     | `aria-hidden="true"`, `data-ars-state`                  |
772	| ProgressText      | `<div>`     | `aria-live="polite"`, `aria-atomic="true"`              |
773	
774	## 3. Accessibility
775	
776	### 3.1 ARIA Roles, States, and Properties
777	
778	The carousel follows the [WAI-ARIA Carousel Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/carousel/).
779	
780	| Element           | Attribute              | Value                                            |
781	| ----------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
782	| Root (`section`)  | `role`                 | `"region"`                                       |
783	| Root              | `aria-roledescription` | `"carousel"`                                     |
784	| Item              | `role`                 | `"group"`                                        |
785	| Item              | `aria-roledescription` | `"slide"`                                        |
786	| Item (hidden)     | `aria-hidden`          | `"true"` + `inert`                               |
787	| IndicatorGroup    | `role`                 | `"tablist"`                                      |
788	| Indicator         | `role`                 | `"tab"`                                          |
789	| Indicator         | `aria-selected`        | `"true"` for current slide                       |
790	| ItemGroup         | `aria-live`            | `"off"` during auto-play, `"polite"` when paused |
791	| AutoPlayIndicator | `aria-hidden`          | `"true"` (purely decorative visual feedback)     |
792	
793	### 3.2 Keyboard Interaction
794	
795	| Key                           | Behaviour                     |
796	| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
797	| `ArrowRight` (horizontal LTR) | Next slide                    |
798	| `ArrowLeft` (horizontal LTR)  | Previous slide                |
799	| `ArrowDown` (vertical)        | Next slide                    |
800	| `ArrowUp` (vertical)          | Previous slide                |
801	| `Home`                        | First slide                   |
802	| `End`                         | Last slide                    |
803	| `Tab`                         | Move focus into slide content |
804	
805	RTL: Arrow keys reverse per `03-accessibility.md` §4.1.
806	
807	### 3.3 Screen Reader Announcements
808	
809	- `aria-live` on `ItemGroup` is `"off"` during auto-play to prevent disruptive announcements, and `"polite"` when paused or stopped.
810	- Auto-play MUST pause on hover (`mouseenter`) and on focus within the carousel (`focusin`). Resumes on `mouseleave` / `focusout` unless `stop_on_interaction` triggered.
811	- Non-current slides receive both `aria-hidden="true"` and `inert`, ensuring they are invisible to assistive technology.
812	
813	## 4. Internationalization
814	
815	### 4.1 Messages
816	
817	```rust
818	#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
819	pub struct Messages {
820	    pub carousel_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
821	    pub role_description: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
822	    pub slide_role_description: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
823	    pub slide_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(usize, usize, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
824	    pub prev_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
825	    pub next_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
826	    pub pause_auto_play_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
827	    pub start_auto_play_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
828	}
829	
830	impl Default for Messages {
831	    fn default() -> Self {
832	        Self {
833	            carousel_label: MessageFn::static_str("Carousel"),
834	            role_description: MessageFn::static_str("carousel"),
835	            slide_role_description: MessageFn::static_str("slide"),
836	            slide_label: MessageFn::new(|index, total, _locale| format!("Slide {index} of {total}")),
837	            prev_label: MessageFn::static_str("Previous slide"),
838	            next_label: MessageFn::static_str("Next slide"),
839	            pause_auto_play_label: MessageFn::static_str("Pause automatic slide show"),
840	            start_auto_play_label: MessageFn::static_str("Start automatic slide show"),
841	        }
842	    }
843	}
844	
845	impl ComponentMessages for Messages {}
846	```
847	
848	RTL: `on_root_keydown()` reverses `ArrowRight`/`ArrowLeft` when `ctx.is_rtl` is `true`. `PrevTrigger` and `NextTrigger` icons swap visually but semantic labels remain "Previous" / "Next". The slide track is ordered left-to-right in the DOM; CSS `direction: rtl` handles visual reversal.
849	
850	## 5. Library Parity
851	
852	> Compared against: Ark UI (`Carousel`).
853	
854	### 5.1 Props
855	
856	| Feature             | ars-ui                        | Ark UI                           | Notes                                             |
857	| ------------------- | ----------------------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
858	| Current slide       | `index` (Bindable)            | `page` / `defaultPage`           | Same concept                                      |
859	| Slide count         | `slide_count`                 | `slideCount`                     | Same                                              |
860	| Loop                | `loop_nav`                    | `loop`                           | Same                                              |
861	| Auto-play           | `auto_play` (AutoPlayOptions) | `autoplay` (boolean or {delay})  | ars-ui richer config                              |
862	| Slides per view     | `slides_per_view`             | `slidesPerPage`                  | Same concept                                      |
863	| Slides per move     | `slides_per_move`             | `slidesPerMove`                  | Adopted from Ark UI                               |
864	| Spacing             | `spacing`                     | `spacing`                        | Same                                              |
865	| Orientation         | `orientation`                 | `orientation`                    | Same                                              |
866	| Alignment           | `align` (SlideAlignment)      | Item-level `snapAlign`           | ars-ui at root, Ark per-item                      |
867	| Swipe threshold     | `swipe_threshold`             | --                               | ars-ui addition                                   |
868	| Transition duration | `transition_duration`         | --                               | ars-ui addition                                   |
869	| RTL                 | `is_rtl`                      | --                               | ars-ui addition                                   |
870	| Mouse drag          | Always enabled                | `allowMouseDrag`                 | ars-ui always supports drag                       |
871	| In-view threshold   | --                            | `inViewThreshold`                | Partial visibility detection; not adopted (niche) |
872	| Snap type           | --                            | `snapType` (proximity/mandatory) | CSS scroll-snap concern; not adopted              |
873	| Padding             | --                            | `padding`                        | CSS concern; consumer can set padding directly    |
874	
875	**Gaps:** None critical. `inViewThreshold`, `snapType`, and `padding` are CSS-level concerns or niche features not adopted.
876	
877	### 5.2 Anatomy
878	
879	| Part              | ars-ui              | Ark UI              | Notes                                          |
880	| ----------------- | ------------------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
881	| Root              | `Root`              | `Root`              | --                                             |
882	| Viewport          | `Viewport`          | --                  | ars-ui separates viewport from root            |
883	| ItemGroup         | `ItemGroup`         | `ItemGroup`         | --                                             |
884	| Item              | `Item`              | `Item`              | --                                             |
885	| PrevTrigger       | `PrevTrigger`       | `PrevTrigger`       | --                                             |
886	| NextTrigger       | `NextTrigger`       | `NextTrigger`       | --                                             |
887	| IndicatorGroup    | `IndicatorGroup`    | `IndicatorGroup`    | --                                             |
888	| Indicator         | `Indicator`         | `Indicator`         | --                                             |
889	| AutoPlayTrigger   | `AutoPlayTrigger`   | `AutoplayTrigger`   | --                                             |
890	| AutoPlayIndicator | `AutoPlayIndicator` | `AutoplayIndicator` | --                                             |
891	| ProgressText      | `ProgressText`      | `ProgressText`      | Adopted from Ark UI                            |
892	| Control           | --                  | `Control`           | Wrapper for prev/next; consumer layout concern |
893	
894	**Gaps:** None. `Control` is a grouping wrapper the consumer can create.
895	
896	### 5.3 Events
897	
898	| Callback        | ars-ui                    | Ark UI                   | Notes                             |
899	| --------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------ | --------------------------------- |
900	| Page change     | `Bindable` change         | `onPageChange`           | Handled via Bindable notification |
901	| Autoplay status | State machine transitions | `onAutoplayStatusChange` | Observable via state              |
902	| Drag status     | State machine transitions | `onDragStatusChange`     | Observable via state              |
903	
904	**Gaps:** None. ars-ui uses state machine transitions instead of explicit callbacks.
905	
906	### 5.4 Features
907	
908	| Feature                     | ars-ui | Ark UI |
909	| --------------------------- | ------ | ------ |
910	| Auto-play with pause/resume | Yes    | Yes    |
911	| Looping                     | Yes    | Yes    |
912	| Pointer/touch drag          | Yes    | Yes    |
913	| Keyboard navigation         | Yes    | Yes    |
914	| Dot indicators              | Yes    | Yes    |
915	| Multi-slide view            | Yes    | Yes    |
916	| Multi-slide advance         | Yes    | Yes    |
917	| Progress text               | Yes    | Yes    |
918	| RTL support                 | Yes    | --     |
919	| Momentum-based swipe        | Yes    | --     |
920	
921	**Gaps:** None.
922	
923	### 5.5 Summary
924	
925	- **Overall:** Full parity.
926	- **Divergences:** ars-ui uses `AutoPlayOptions` struct instead of Ark's boolean-or-object; ars-ui includes momentum-based swipe detection; ars-ui has explicit `Viewport` part that Ark folds into Root.
927	- **Recommended additions:** None.
928

I have thoroughly explored the `Splitter` module and core frameworks to understand exact implementation patterns for stateful layout components. Below is a precise breakdown with real code references.

### 1. FILE/MODULE STRUCTURE (splitter/)

### 2. MACHINE TRAIT IMPLEMENTATION

**Signature** (`lib.rs`:809-818, splitter/mod.rs:809-816):
```rust
pub trait Machine: Sized + 'static {
    type State: Clone + Debug + PartialEq;
    type Event: Clone + Debug;
    type Context: Clone + Debug;
    type Props: Clone + PartialEq + HasId;
    type Messages: ComponentMessages + Clone + Default + 'static;
    type Effect: EffectName;
    type Api<'a>: ConnectApi where Self: 'a;
    
    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (State, Context);
    fn transition(state: &State, event: &Event, context: &Context, props: &Props) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>>;
    fn connect<'a>(state: &'a State, ctx: &'a Context, props: &'a Props, send: &'a dyn Fn(Event)) -> Api<'a>;
    fn on_props_changed(_old: &Props, _new: &Props) -> Vec<Event> { Vec::new() }
}
```

**Splitter's impl** (splitter/mod.rs:809-1069):

```rust
impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
    type State = State;
    type Event = Event;
    type Context = Context;
    type Props = Props;
    type Messages = Messages;
    type Effect = NoEffect;
    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;

    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (State, Context) {
        (State::Idle, Context::from_props(props, env, messages))
    }

    fn transition(
        state: &Self::State,
        event: &Self::Event,
        ctx: &Self::Context,
        _props: &Self::Props,
    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
        match (state, event) {
            // Example: line 835-840
            (State::Idle, Event::DragStart { handle_index, pos })
                if pos.is_finite() && valid_handle(*handle_index, ctx.sizes.get().len(), ctx.panels.len()) =>
            {
                let handle_index = *handle_index;
                let pos = *pos;
                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Dragging { handle_index }).apply(
                    move |ctx: &mut Context| {
                        ctx.drag_start_sizes = ctx.sizes.get().clone();
                        ctx.drag_start_pos = pos;
                    },
                ))
            }
            // ... more arms
        }
    }

    fn connect<'a>(
        state: &'a Self::State,
        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
        props: &'a Self::Props,
        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
        Api { state, ctx, props, send }
    }

    fn on_props_changed(old: &Self::Props, new: &Self::Props) -> Vec<Self::Event> {
        assert_eq!(old.id, new.id, "Splitter id cannot change after initialization");
        if old == new {
            Vec::new()
        } else {
            vec![Event::SyncProps { props: new.clone() }]
        }
    }
}
```

### 10. KEY PATTERN INSIGHTS FOR CAROUSEL IMPLEMENTATION

1. **Monolithic module** — keep all types in single `mod.rs` file unless extremely large
2. **Machine trait** — concrete impl block with all 6 methods; `NoEffect` for stateless transitions
3. **Part enum** — use `#[derive(ComponentPart)]` with `#[scope = "carousel"]`; supports indexed variants
4. **TransitionPlan** — chain `.to()`, `.apply()`, `.context_only()` fluidly; use `.new()` for explicit no-ops
5. **AttrMap** — use `.set()` for all attributes, `.set_bool()` for boolean-valued attrs, `.set_style()` for CSS
6. **Messages** — wrap custom closures in `MessageFn::new(...)` or use `MessageFn::static_str(...)` for defaults
7. **Props builder** — all setters return `self` for chaining; use `HasId` derive for automatic ID management
8. **Context** — includes `Bindable<_>` for controlled/uncontrolled values, `ComponentIds` for DOM ID generation, `Locale` + `Messages` for i18n

All patterns above are **exact signatures and call sites** from production code.

**Real proptest example for Splitter** (from `/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/impl-278/crates/ars-components/tests/proptest_state_machines/layout.rs:442-585`):

```rust
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
enum SplitterStep {
    Send(splitter::Event),
    SetProps(splitter::Props),
}

fn arb_splitter_props() -> impl Strategy<Value = splitter::Props> {
    (
        prop_oneof![Just(Orientation::Horizontal), Just(Orientation::Vertical)],
        prop_oneof![Just(Direction::Ltr), Just(Direction::Rtl)],
        prop_oneof![
            Just(splitter::SizeUnit::Percent),
            Just(splitter::SizeUnit::Pixels)
        ],
    )
        .prop_map(|(orientation, dir, size_unit)| {
            splitter::Props::new()
                .id("split")
                .panels(vec![
                    splitter_panel("left", 40.0),
                    splitter_panel("middle", 30.0),
                    splitter_panel("right", 30.0),
                ])
                .orientation(orientation)
                .dir(dir)
                .size_unit(size_unit)
                .default_sizes(vec![40.0, 30.0, 30.0])
        })
}

fn arb_splitter_event() -> impl Strategy<Value = splitter::Event> {
    prop_oneof![
        (0usize..4, -200.0f64..200.0)
            .prop_map(|(handle_index, pos)| { splitter::Event::DragStart { handle_index, pos } }),
        (-200.0f64..200.0).prop_map(|pos| splitter::Event::DragMove { pos }),
        Just(splitter::Event::DragEnd),
        // ... more event variants
        prop::collection::vec(0.0f64..100.0, 0..5)
            .prop_map(|sizes| splitter::Event::SetSizes { sizes }),
    ]
}

fn arb_splitter_step() -> impl Strategy<Value = SplitterStep> {
    prop_oneof![
        arb_splitter_event().prop_map(SplitterStep::Send),
        arb_splitter_props().prop_map(SplitterStep::SetProps),
    ]
}

fn assert_splitter_invariants(service: &Service<splitter::Machine>) -> TestCaseResult {
    let sizes = service.context().sizes.get();

    prop_assert_eq!(sizes.len(), service.context().panels.len());
    prop_assert!(sizes.iter().all(|size| size.is_finite()));
    prop_assert!(service.context().keyboard_step.is_finite());
    prop_assert!(service.context().drag_scale_factor.is_finite());

    if let Some(handle_index) = service.context().focused_handle {
        prop_assert!(handle_index + 1 < sizes.len());
    }

    if let splitter::State::Dragging { handle_index } = service.state() {
        prop_assert!(*handle_index + 1 < sizes.len());
        prop_assert_eq!(service.context().drag_start_sizes.len(), sizes.len());
    }

    Ok(())
}

proptest! {
    #![proptest_config(super::common::proptest_config())]

    #[test]
    #[ignore = "proptest — nightly extended-proptest job"]
    fn proptest_splitter_event_sequences_preserve_invariants(
        props in arb_splitter_props(),
        steps in prop::collection::vec(arb_splitter_step(), 0..128),
    ) {
        let mut service = Service::<splitter::Machine>::new(
            props,
            &Env::default(),
            &splitter::Messages::default(),
        );

        assert_splitter_invariants(&service)?;

        for step in steps {
            match step {
                SplitterStep::Send(event) => {
                    drop(service.send(event));
                }

                SplitterStep::SetProps(props) => {
                    drop(service.set_props(props));
                }
            }

            assert_splitter_invariants(&service)?;
        }
    }
}
```

**Key patterns:**
- Proptest tests are `#[ignore = "proptest — nightly extended-proptest job"]`
- Use `#![proptest_config(super::common::proptest_config())]` inside `proptest!` macro
- Generate arbitrary Props, Events, and Steps using `prop_oneof!` and `prop_map`
- Create `Service::new()` once, then iterate through random event sequences
- Assert invariants BEFORE processing steps and AFTER each step
- Return `TestCaseResult` (`prop_assert!` macros)

**Helper implementation** (from `/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/impl-278/crates/ars-components/tests/spec_conformance/helper.rs:24-75`):

```rust
pub(crate) fn assert_anatomy<P>(expected_scope: &'static str, expected_parts: &[(P, &'static str)])
where
    P: ComponentPart + core::fmt::Debug + PartialEq,
{
    assert_eq!(
        P::scope(),
        expected_scope,
        "Part::scope() must match spec §3 anatomy",
    );

    let actual = P::all();

    let actual_names = actual.iter().map(ComponentPart::name).collect::<Vec<_>>();

    let expected_names = expected_parts
        .iter()
        .map(|(_, name)| *name)
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();

    assert_eq!(
        actual_names, expected_names,
        "Part::all() name list must equal spec §3 anatomy column \
         (scope = {expected_scope:?})",
    );

    assert_eq!(
        actual.len(),
        expected_parts.len(),
        "Part::all() length must match the number of spec §3 anatomy rows",
    );

    for (actual_part, (expected_part, expected_name)) in actual.iter().zip(expected_parts) {
        assert_eq!(
            actual_part.name(),
            *expected_name,
            "Part {actual_part:?} must produce kebab-name {expected_name:?}",
        );
        assert_eq!(
            actual_part, expected_part,
            "Part::all()[i] must equal the expected part value",
        );
    }

    if let Some((first_expected, _)) = expected_parts.first() {
        assert_eq!(
            &P::ROOT,
            first_expected,
            "Workspace convention: Part::ROOT (the first variant) must \
             equal the first spec-declared part",
        );
    }
}
```

**What it checks:**
1. `Part::scope()` returns correct `data-ars-scope` string
2. `Part::all()` produces all variants in correct order
3. Each `Part::name()` matches kebab-case string from spec
4. `Part::ROOT` equals first variant (workspace convention)

## **KEY ISSUE FOUND:**

**The carousel spec shows `set_interval()` and `clear_interval()` called directly in the Machine transition code.** This violates the framework-agnostic contract. The correct pattern is:

1. Define an `Effect` enum with named variants
2. Emit `with_named_effect("auto-play", closure)` 
3. Let framework adapters call `PlatformEffects::set_timeout(Duration, callback) -> TimerHandle`

The Toast component demonstrates this correctly: `/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/impl-278/crates/ars-components/src/overlay/toast/single.rs:50-57` defines `Effect::DurationTimer`, and the spec notes (lines 11-18) explain that adapters translate effect intents into actual timers.

//! Owns a single toast's lifecycle (`Visible → Paused → Dismissing → Dismissed`),
//! the auto-dismiss countdown intent, the swipe gesture state, and the ARIA /
//! data attribute output for the toast anatomy parts (`Root`, `Title`,
//! `Description`, `ActionTrigger`, `CloseTrigger`, `ProgressBar`).
//!
//! The `aria-live` region shells live one layer up — see
//! [`super::manager::Api::region_attrs`] — because they belong to the
//! manager's lifetime, not any individual toast.
//!
//! The agnostic core never reads `performance.now()`, never installs document
//! listeners, and never measures viewport geometry. Adapters own the clock and
//! hand pause snapshots back atomically through
//! [`Event::Pause`]; auto-dismiss, exit-animation, announcement, and
//! `on_open_change` intents are surfaced as the typed [`Effect`] enum so
//! framework adapters can translate them into `set_timeout`, `announce`, and
//! consumer callbacks (see `spec/components/overlay/toast.md` §1.6).

use alloc::{
    string::{String, ToString as _},
    vec::Vec,
};
use core::{
    fmt::{self, Debug},
    time::Duration,
};

use ars_core::{
    AriaAttr, AttrMap, AttrValue, ComponentIds, ComponentMessages, ComponentPart, ConnectApi, Env,
    HtmlAttr, Locale, MessageFn, PendingEffect, TransitionPlan,
};

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Effect
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Typed identifier for every named effect intent the per-toast machine
/// emits.
///
/// Adapters dispatch on `effect.name` exhaustively (`match effect.name {
/// toast::single::Effect::DurationTimer => …, … }`) so name typos and
/// unhandled variants surface at compile time — the same convention used by
/// [`dialog::Effect`](crate::overlay::dialog::Effect),
/// [`popover::Effect`](crate::overlay::popover::Effect), and
/// [`tooltip::Effect`](crate::overlay::tooltip::Effect). The variant names
/// themselves are the contract; there is no parallel kebab-case wire form to
/// keep in sync.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum Effect {
    /// Adapter starts (or restarts) the auto-dismiss countdown using
    /// `Context::remaining.unwrap_or(Context::duration)` and dispatches
    /// [`Event::DurationExpired`] when the timer fires. Emitted on initial
    /// mount when `duration.is_some()`, on every `Paused → Visible`
    /// transition, and cancelled on `Visible → Paused` and `Visible →
    /// Dismissing` transitions.
    DurationTimer,

    /// Adapter waits for the toast's exit animation to complete (or for the
    /// configured `Provider::remove_delay` when animations are skipped) and
    /// dispatches [`Event::AnimationComplete`]. Emitted on every transition
    /// into [`State::Dismissing`].
    ExitAnimation,

    /// Adapter inserts the toast's title/description into the polite
    /// `aria-live` region. Emitted on initial mount for `Kind::Info`,
    /// `Kind::Success`, and `Kind::Loading` toasts.
    AnnouncePolite,

    /// Adapter inserts the toast's title/description into the assertive
    /// `aria-live` region. Emitted on initial mount for `Kind::Warning` and
    /// `Kind::Error` toasts (per `aria-live="assertive"` urgency).
    AnnounceAssertive,

    /// Adapter invokes consumer-supplied open-change callbacks (e.g.
    /// `manager::Config::on_pause_change`-equivalent open hooks) with the
    /// post-transition open state. Emitted on every transition into
    /// [`State::Dismissing`].
    OpenChange,
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// State
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// States for the [`Toast`](self) component.
///
/// Toast uses a four-state lifecycle so adapters can distinguish
/// `Visible` (auto-dismiss timer running), `Paused` (timer cancelled but
/// the toast remains on-screen), `Dismissing` (exit animation running,
/// `open` already false for `Presence`), and `Dismissed` (terminal —
/// the surrounding [`Provider`](super::manager) removes the toast).
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum State {
    /// The toast is on-screen with its auto-dismiss timer running (when a
    /// finite [`Props::duration`] is set) or persistent (when
    /// [`Props::duration`] is `None`, e.g. `Kind::Loading`).
    #[default]
    Visible,

    /// The toast is on-screen with its auto-dismiss timer cancelled because
    /// the pointer is hovering, focus moved into the content, or the
    /// surrounding region requested a global pause.
    Paused,

    /// The toast was dismissed (auto-dismiss, manual dismiss, or swipe) and
    /// the adapter is running its exit animation. `open` is already `false`
    /// so adapters composing with [`Presence`](super::super::presence) can
    /// drive the unmount transition.
    Dismissing,

    /// Terminal state. The surrounding manager observes this and removes the
    /// toast from its visible list.
    Dismissed,
}

// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Event
// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Events accepted by the [`Toast`](self) state machine.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Event {
    /// Programmatic dismissal request (close button click, `DismissAll` from
    /// the surrounding manager, etc.). Always transitions to
    /// [`State::Dismissing`] from either `Visible` or `Paused`.
    Dismiss,

    /// Pause the auto-dismiss countdown. Cancels [`Effect::DurationTimer`]
    /// and atomically records the remaining time so callers cannot observe
    /// a "paused but `remaining == None`" intermediate state.
    Pause {
        /// Remaining auto-dismiss time read from the adapter's clock at the
        /// moment of pause, clamped to zero. The agnostic core writes it
        /// straight into [`Context::remaining`].
        remaining: Duration,
    },

    /// Resume the auto-dismiss countdown. Re-emits [`Effect::DurationTimer`]
    /// so the adapter can restart its `set_timeout` using

enum CollapsibleStep {

    SetProps(collapsible::Props),
}

fn arb_collapsible_props() -> impl Strategy<Value = collapsible::Props> {
    (
        prop::option::of(any::<bool>()),
        any::<bool>(),
        any::<bool>(),
        prop::option::of("[1-9][0-9]{0,2}px".prop_map(String::from)),
        prop::option::of("[1-9][0-9]{0,2}px".prop_map(String::from)),
    )
        .prop_map(
            |(open, default_open, disabled, collapsed_height, collapsed_width)| {
                let mut props = collapsible::Props::new()
                    .id("collapsible")
                    .default_open(default_open)
                    .disabled(disabled);

                if let Some(open) = open {
                    props = props.open(open);
                }

                if let Some(collapsed_height) = collapsed_height {
                    props = props.collapsed_height(collapsed_height);
                }

                if let Some(collapsed_width) = collapsed_width {
                    props = props.collapsed_width(collapsed_width);
                }

//! Spec-conformance tests for `crates/ars-components/src/layout/*`.
//!
//! Each test pulls the expected anatomy from the corresponding component
//! spec's §2 anatomy table and asserts the impl's `Part` enum matches.

use ars_components::layout::{
    aspect_ratio, center, collapsible, frame, grid, scroll_area, splitter, stack, toolbar,
};

use super::helper::assert_anatomy;

#[test]
fn aspect_ratio_anatomy_matches_spec() {
    assert_anatomy("aspect-ratio", &[(aspect_ratio::Part::Root, "root")]);
}

#[test]
fn frame_anatomy_matches_spec() {
    assert_anatomy(
        "frame",
        &[(frame::Part::Root, "root"), (frame::Part::Iframe, "iframe")],
    );
}

#[test]
fn stack_anatomy_matches_spec() {
    assert_anatomy("stack", &[(stack::Part::Root, "root")]);
}

# Task #278 — Implement Carousel agnostic core

## Context

GitHub issue #278 (epic #226, Agnostic layout components, 5 pts, Unit tier) asks for the
framework-agnostic `Carousel` state machine in `crates/ars-components`. The carousel presents a
sequence of slides with prev/next buttons, dot indicators, keyboard arrows, pointer-swipe with
momentum, looping, and auto-play with pause-on-hover/focus. The core owns slide index, loop /
transition / autoplay state, swipe-threshold math from injected pointer deltas, and ARIA attrs.
Adapters (out of scope here) own live viewport/track handles, scrolling/transform application,
focus movement, hover/focus listeners, and geometry reads — the agnostic code must never query DOM
nodes by ID or call timer/DOM APIs directly.

The spec (`spec/components/layout/carousel.md`) is the contract and is already detailed
(§1 state machine, §1.6 connect/API, §2 anatomy, §3 a11y, §4 i18n). Implementation must match it
exactly, **except** for three points where the spec's code examples conflict with the workspace's
agnostic-effect architecture and must be synced in this same PR (see "Spec synchronization").

## Spec synchronization (land in this PR)

The spec's §1.5 `Machine` example calls `set_interval(...)` / `clear_interval(...)` directly inside
transition closures. That violates the agnostic contract (the issue's own acceptance criteria) and
those functions do not exist in the agnostic layer. Timers are a `PlatformEffects` concern resolved
by adapters. The established workspace pattern is a **typed `Effect` enum** emitted as a named
marker (`PendingEffect::named(...)`) that adapters dispatch on — see
[toast single.rs](crates/ars-components/src/overlay/toast/single.rs#L38-L80) (`Effect::DurationTimer`)
and the `EffectName`/`PendingEffect`/`with_effect`/`cancel_effect` machinery in
[ars-core/src/lib.rs](crates/ars-core/src/lib.rs#L160-L294).

Edits to `spec/components/layout/carousel.md` §1.5:

1. **Add an `Effect` enum** with one variant `AutoPlayTimer` (recurring interval intent: adapter
   runs an interval of `ctx.auto_play.interval` dispatching `Event::AutoPlayTick`; cancel stops it).
   Set `type Effect = Effect;` in the `Machine` impl.
2. **Replace** every `.with_named_effect("auto-play", move |_ctx,_props,send| { set_interval(...) ...})`
   with `.with_effect(PendingEffect::named(Effect::AutoPlayTimer))`, and every
   `.cancel_effect("auto-play")` with `.cancel_effect(Effect::AutoPlayTimer)`.
   Affects `AutoPlayStart`, `AutoPlayStop`, `AutoPlayResume`, `AutoPlayPause`, `PointerDown`, `Blur`.
3. **Add an `initial_effects` override**: `init` returns `State::AutoPlaying` when
   `props.auto_play.is_some()`, but no `AutoPlayStart` event ever fires on mount, so the timer would
   never start. Mirror toast/popover/dialog: emit `vec![PendingEffect::named(Effect::AutoPlayTimer)]`
   from `initial_effects` when `*state == State::AutoPlaying`. Adapters drain via
   `Service::take_initial_effects()` (already wired in both adapters).
4. **Fix imports**: spec shows `use crate::{Bindable, Duration}`. `Duration` is `core::time::Duration`
   (not re-exported by `ars-core`); `Bindable` is `ars_core::Bindable`. Update the spec snippet's
   `use` line to match how implementations actually import (mirror splitter's
   `use ars_core::{...};` + `use core::time::Duration;`).

No other spec deviations. All field names, method names, signatures, ARIA values, and the 11-part
anatomy are implemented verbatim from the spec.

## Files to create / modify

**New component module** — single-file module per workspace convention (splitter is the template):
- `crates/ars-components/src/layout/carousel/mod.rs` — `State`, `Event`, `Effect`, `SlideAlignment`,
  `AutoPlayOptions`, `Context` (+ `current_index`/`clamp_index`/`can_go_prev`/`can_go_next`/
  `track_offset_percent`), `Props` (+ `Default`), `Messages` (+ `Default`, `ComponentMessages`),
  `Machine` (impl `ars_core::Machine`), `Part` (`#[derive(ComponentPart)] #[scope="carousel"]`),
  `Api<'a>`, `impl ConnectApi for Api`, and the `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` (unit + snapshot tests).

**Module wiring**:
- `crates/ars-components/src/layout/mod.rs` — add `pub mod carousel;` with a `///` doc line
  (alphabetical, before `center`).

**Tests** (mirror splitter's locations):
- `crates/ars-components/tests/spec_conformance/layout.rs` — add `carousel` to the `use` list and a
  `carousel_anatomy_matches_spec` test covering all 11 parts via `assert_anatomy`.
- `crates/ars-components/tests/proptest_state_machines/layout.rs` — add `carousel` to the `use` list,
  an `arb_carousel_props`/`arb_carousel_event`/`arb_carousel_step` strategy set, an invariants
  assertion, and a `proptest_carousel_event_sequences_preserve_invariants` test
  (`#[ignore = "proptest — nightly extended-proptest job"]`, `#![proptest_config(super::common::proptest_config())]`).
- Snapshot `.snap` fixtures land under `crates/ars-components/src/layout/carousel/snapshots/`
  (insta auto-creates; commit them; add `snapshot-reviewed` label on the PR).

## Key APIs to reuse (verified, do not re-derive)

- `ars_core::{Machine, TransitionPlan, PendingEffect, ConnectApi, ComponentPart, ComponentMessages,
  ComponentIds, Bindable, MessageFn, Env, Locale, AttrMap, HtmlAttr, AriaAttr, CssProperty,
  KeyboardKey, Orientation, no_cleanup}` and `ars_core::HasId` (derive). `Orientation` is from
  `ars_i18n` but re-exported through `ars_core` (splitter imports it from `ars_core`).
- `KeyboardEventData` for `on_root_keydown` — confirm its import path during impl
  (`ars_interactions::keyboard::KeyboardEventData`; check whether splitter/other layout components
  re-route through a local `KeyboardEvent` like splitter does, and follow the spec's
  `KeyboardEventData` type literally).
- `core::num::NonZero` (spec uses `NonZero<usize>`), `core::time::Duration`.
- `TransitionPlan`: `to(state)`, `new()`, `context_only(f)`, `apply(f)`, `with_effect(PendingEffect)`,
  `cancel_effect(effect)`. `PendingEffect::named(Effect::AutoPlayTimer)`.
- `AttrMap`: `set(HtmlAttr, impl Into<AttrValue>)`, `set_bool(HtmlAttr, bool)`,
  `set_style(CssProperty, impl Into<String>)`; `Part::Root.data_attrs()` returns
  `[(HtmlAttr,&str);2]`.
- Construct `Props` in tests via struct-literal `Props { ..Props::default() }` (spec defines no
  builder — stay spec-exact; do not invent one).

## TDD order (tests first)

Write/commit failing tests, then implement until green. The issue's "Tests to add first" maps to:

1. **spec_conformance**: `carousel_anatomy_matches_spec` (11 parts, scope `"carousel"`).
2. **Unit tests** in `mod tests` (drive via `Service::<Machine>::new(props, &Env::default(),
   &Messages::default())`, `service.send(event)`, `service.state()`, `service.context()`,
   `service.connect(&|_| {})`):
   - State transitions: `Idle`/`AutoPlaying` init by `auto_play`, `GoToSlide`→`Transitioning`,
     `TransitionEnd`→`Idle`/`AutoPlaying`, guard that `Transitioning` blocks nav.
   - Slide navigation: next/prev/goTo honor `slides_per_move`, clamp vs wrap via `loop_nav`,
     `can_go_prev`/`can_go_next` at boundaries.
   - Auto-play: `initial_effects` emits `Effect::AutoPlayTimer` when booted into `AutoPlaying`;
     `AutoPlayTick` advances; `AutoPlayStart`/`Stop`/`Resume` effect+cancel behavior;
     `stop_on_interaction` sets `auto_play_stopped` on manual nav.
   - Pause-on-hover/focus: `AutoPlayPause`/`FocusSlide`(pause_on_focus)/`Blur` resume; cancel timer.
   - Loop mode wraps (`clamp_index` modulo) and clamps when `loop_nav=false`.
   - Swipe: inject `PointerDown`/`PointerMove`/`PointerUp` deltas+timestamps; assert
     `drag_delta`/`swipe_velocity`/threshold + velocity-flick (×0.3) navigation; `PointerCancel` resets.
   - Keyboard: `on_root_keydown` arrow mapping (horizontal LTR/RTL swap, vertical), Home/End.
   - `track_offset_percent` math (drag correction, per-slide).
3. **Snapshot tests** (`insta::assert_snapshot!` of `format!("{attrs:#?}")` helper) covering
   `connect()`/`Api` `AttrMap` for **every anatomy part** and each output-affecting branch:
   - `root_attrs` × each `State` (idle / auto-playing / transitioning) × orientation
     (horizontal / vertical).
   - `viewport_attrs` × orientation (touch-action pan-y/pan-x).
   - `item_group_attrs` × live `polite` (no/stopped autoplay) vs `off` (active autoplay).
   - `item_attrs` current vs hidden (aria-hidden + inert).
   - `prev_trigger_attrs`/`next_trigger_attrs` at boundary (aria-disabled) vs mid / loop.
   - `indicator_group_attrs`, `indicator_attrs` selected vs not.
   - `auto_play_trigger_attrs` playing vs paused; `autoplay_indicator_attrs` playing vs paused.
   - `progress_text_attrs` + `progress_text()` string.
   - Snapshots must pass `cargo insta test --unreferenced=reject`.
4. **proptest**: random `Props` + event/`set_props` sequences preserve invariants — index always
   `< slide_count`, `drag_delta`/`swipe_velocity` finite, state-machine consistency, no panic on
   `clamp_index` isize casts.

## Implementation notes / edge cases

- `clamp_index(isize)`: implement exactly as spec (modulo wrap vs saturating clamp). Guard proptest
  inputs so the `as isize` casts don't overflow on absurd `slide_count` (use realistic ranges).
- `AutoPlayTick` is dropped unless `state == AutoPlaying` (spec guard) — the recurring interval may
  fire during the brief `Transitioning` window; the guard ignores it, matching spec intent.
- `item_group` `aria-live` is `polite` when autoplay is absent/stopped, `off` while actively playing
  (spec §3.1) — verify branch matches `auto_play_stopped || auto_play.is_none()`.
- Document every public item (`missing_docs`); derive doc text from spec semantics, not signatures.
- Minimize clones; no `.unwrap()` (use `.expect("...")`); `#[expect(...)]` not `#[allow(...)]`.

## Post-implementation (mandatory, per CLAUDE.md)

- After named tests pass: invoke `post-implementation-audit` skill (all three phases — drift,
  iterative "anything missing", test-coverage); fix every finding in this PR.
- Run `cargo xtask spec validate` after editing the spec.
- Present result for user review before any commit.
- On approval: `cargo xci-fast`, fix failures, then commit + push PR to `main` with `Closes #278`,
  add `snapshot-reviewed` label (new `.snap` files), then `waiting-for-codex-review` skill.
- Move issue to In Progress on the board at start; close only after merge + CI green + Codex 👍.

## Verification

- `cargo test -p ars-components --lib layout::carousel` — unit + snapshot tests pass, zero warnings.
- `cargo insta test -p ars-components --unreferenced=reject` — snapshots committed & referenced.
- `cargo test -p ars-components --test spec_conformance layout::carousel_anatomy_matches_spec`.
- `cargo test -p ars-components --test proptest_state_machines layout::proptest_carousel -- --ignored`
  (spot-check locally; nightly runs the full extended job).
- `cargo xtask spec validate` (spec frontmatter still consistent after §1.5 edits).
- `cargo xci-fast` green before push.

  "old_string": "### 1.5 Full Machine Implementation\n\n```rust\npub struct Machine;\n\nimpl ars_core::Machine for Machine {\n    type State = State;\n    type Event = Event;\n    type Context = Context;\n    type Props = Props;\n    type Messages = Messages;\n    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;",
  "new_string": "### 1.5 Full Machine Implementation\n\nAuto-play timing is an adapter concern, not an agnostic one: the core never calls\n`set_interval`/`set_timeout` directly. Instead it emits a typed [`Effect`] marker that adapters\ndispatch on (`match effect.name { Effect::AutoPlayTimer => … }`) — the same convention used by\n`toast::single::Effect`, `dialog::Effect`, `popover::Effect`, and `tooltip::Effect`. The adapter\nresolving `Effect::AutoPlayTimer` runs a recurring interval of `ctx.auto_play.interval` that\ndispatches `Event::AutoPlayTick`, and tears it down when the effect is cancelled.\n\n```rust\n/// Typed identifier for every named effect intent the carousel machine emits.\n///\n/// Adapters dispatch on `effect.name` exhaustively so unhandled variants and\n/// name typos surface at compile time.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub enum Effect {\n    /// Adapter starts (or restarts) a recurring auto-play interval of\n    /// `Context::auto_play.interval` that dispatches `Event::AutoPlayTick`.\n    /// Emitted on mount when the carousel boots into `State::AutoPlaying`\n    /// (see `initial_effects`), on `AutoPlayStart`, on `AutoPlayResume`, and\n    /// on `Blur` when resuming a focus/hover pause. Cancelled on\n    /// `AutoPlayStop`, `AutoPlayPause`, and `PointerDown`.\n    AutoPlayTimer,\n}\n\npub struct Machine;\n\nimpl ars_core::Machine for Machine {\n    type State = State;\n    type Event = Event;\n    type Context = Context;\n    type Props = Props;\n    type Messages = Messages;\n    type Effect = Effect;\n    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;"
}

pub trait Machine: Sized + 'static {
    /// The state type representing the machine's current configuration.
    type State: Clone + Debug + PartialEq;

    /// The event type that triggers state transitions.
    type Event: Clone + Debug;

    /// Internal context accumulated across transitions (e.g. focused index, scroll offset).
    type Context: Clone + Debug;

    /// External configuration passed in by the parent component.
    type Props: Clone + PartialEq + HasId;

    /// Per-component i18n messages type.
    type Messages: ComponentMessages + Clone + Default + 'static;

    /// Typed identifier for the named effect intents this machine emits.
    ///
    /// Each component declares its own enum (e.g. `popover::Effect`,
    /// `dialog::Effect`) — every variant is a stable identifier the
    /// compiler treats as the single source of truth. Adapters that
    /// route on names use exhaustive `match effect.name { … }` so a new
    /// variant added in the component forces every adapter to update.
    ///
    /// Machines that never emit named effects use [`NoEffect`]; the
    /// uninhabited type makes `PendingEffect::<_>::named(...)`
    /// uncallable for that machine.
    ///
    /// Prototypes and internal test fixtures can use
    /// `type Effect = &'static str` — `&'static str` already implements
    /// [`EffectName`] — but production machines should prefer a
    /// bespoke enum so authoring code, adapter dispatch, and test
    /// fixtures share one typed identifier. See [`EffectName`] for the
    /// full bound rationale.
    type Effect: EffectName;

    /// The connect API type that produces attributes from current state.
    type Api<'a>: ConnectApi

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// The anatomy parts of the [`Carousel`](self) component.\n#[derive(ComponentPart)]\n#[scope = \"carousel\"]\npub enum Part {\n    /// The root carousel region (`<section>`).\n    Root,\n    /// The viewport that clips the slide track.\n    Viewport,\n    /// The group wrapping all slides (the live region).\n    ItemGroup,\n }\n}\n\nimpl Api<'_> {\n    /// Attributes for the root carousel region.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();\n        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);\n        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, \"region\");\n        attrs.set(\n            HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label),\n            (self.ctx.messages.carousel_label)(&self.ctx.locale),\n        );\n        attrs.set(\n            HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::RoleDescription),\n            (self.ctx.messages.role_description)(&self.ctx.locale),\n        );\n        attrs.set(\n            HtmlAttr::Data(\"ars-state\"),\n Orientation::Vertical => \"vertical\",\n            },\n        );\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for the viewport that clips the slide track.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn viewport_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Viewport.data_attrs();\n        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);\n        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);\n        let touch_action = if self.ctx.orientation == Orientation::Horizontal {\n            \"pan-y\"\n        } else {\n            \"pan-x\"\n        };\n        attrs.set_style(CssProperty::Overflow, \"hidden\");\n        attrs.set_style(CssProperty::TouchAction, touch_action);\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for the group wrapping all slides (the live region).\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn item_group_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::ItemGroup.data_attrs();\n        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);\n        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);\n        let live = if self.ctx.auto_play_stopped || self.ctx.auto_play.is_none() {\n            \"polite\"\n        } else {\n            \"off\"\n        };\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Live), live);\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for a single slide by index.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn item_attrs(&self, index: usize) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = (Part::Item { index }).data_attrs();\n        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);\n        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);\n        let is_current = index == self.ctx.current_index();\n        let is_hidden = !is_current;\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, \"group\");\n        attrs.set(\n            HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::RoleDescription),\n HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label),\n            (self.ctx.messages.next_label)(&self.ctx.locale),\n        );\n        if !self.ctx.can_go_next() {\n indicator_group_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::IndicatorGroup.data_attrs();\n        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);\n        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, \"tablist\");\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for a single dot indicator by       HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Selected),\n            if index == self.ctx.current_index() {\n                \"true\"\n            } else {\n                \"false\"\n            },\n        );\n let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::AutoPlayTrigger.data_attrs();\n        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);\n        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);\n        let is_playing = !self.ctx.auto_play_stopped && !self.ctx.auto_play_paused;\n        let label = if is_playing {\n            (self.ctx.messages.pause_auto_play_label)(&self.ctx.locale)\n        } else {\n            (self.ctx.messages.start_auto_play_label)(&self.ctx.locale)\n        };\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label), label);\n        attrs.set(\n            HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Pressed),\n            if is_playing { \"true\" } else { \"false\" },\n        );\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for the decorative auto-play status indicator.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn autoplay_indicator_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::AutoPlayIndicator.data_attrs();\n        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);\n        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);\n        let is_playing = !self.ctx.auto_play_stopped && !self.ctx.auto_play_paused;\n        attrs.set(\n            HtmlAttr::Data(\"ars-state\"),\n            if is_playing { \"playing\" } else { \"paused\" },\n        );\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Hidden), \"true\");\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for the progress text element (e.g. \"2 of 5\").\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn progress_text_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::ProgressText.data_attrs();\n        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);\n        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Live), \"polite\");\n        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Atomic), \"true\");\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Human-readable progress string (e.g. \"Slide 2 of 5\").\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn progress_text(&self) -> String {\n        (self.ctx.messages.slide_label)(\n            self.ctx.current_index() + 1,\n            self.ctx.slide_count.get(),\n            &self.ctx.locale,\n        )\n    }\n\n    /// Handle a keydown on the root region: arrow keys navigate (reversed for\n    /// RTL horizontal carousels), `Home`/`End` jump to the first/last slide.\n    pub fn on_root_keydown(&self, data: &KeyboardEventData) {\n        let is_horizontal = self.ctx.orientation == Orientation::Horizontal;\n        let (prev_key, next_key) = if is_horizontal {\n            if self.ctx.is_rtl {\n                (KeyboardKey::ArrowRight, KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft)\n            } else {\n                (KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft, KeyboardKey::ArrowRight)\n            }\n        } else {\n            (KeyboardKey::ArrowUp, KeyboardKey::ArrowDown)\n        };\n        match data.key {\n            key if key == prev_key => (self.send)(Event::GoToPrev),\n            key if key == next_key => self.ctx.slide_count.get().saturating_sub(1),\n            }),\n            _ => {}\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Dispatch a previous-slide navigation.\n    pub fn on_prev_trigger_click(&self) {\n        (self.send)(Event::GoToPrev);\n    }\n\n    /// Dispatch a next-slide navigation.\n    pub fn on_next_trigger_click(&self) {\n        (self.send)(Event::GoToNext);\n    }\n\n    /// Dispatch navigation to the indicator's slide.\n    pub fn on_indicator_click(&self, index: usize) {\n        (self.send)(Event::GoToSlide { index });\n    }\n\n    /// Toggle auto-play: resume when stopped/paused, otherwise pause.\n    pub fn on_auto_play_trigger_click(&self) {\n        if self.ctx.auto_play_stopped || self.ctx.auto_play_paused {\n pointer-move during a drag.\n    pub fn on_viewport_pointermove(&self, pos: f64, timestamp: f64) {\n        (self.send)(Event::PointerMove { pos, timestamp });\n    }\n\n    /// Dispatch a pointer-up (drag end).\n    pub fn on_viewport_pointerup(&self) {\n        (self.send)(Event::PointerUp);\n    }\n}\n\nimpl ConnectApi for Api<'_> {\n    type Part = Part;\n\n    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part)   "new_string": "    fn keydown(key: KeyboardKey) -> KeyboardEventData {\n        KeyboardEventData {\n            key,\n            character: None,\n            code: String::new(),\n            shift_key: false,\n            ctrl_key: false,\n            alt_key: false,\n            meta_key: false,\n            repeat: false,\n            is_composing: false,\n        }\n    }"

Implementation complete and fully verified. Here is the result for your review.

## Task #278 — Carousel agnostic core

Implemented the framework-agnostic `Carousel` state machine in `ars-components`, matching `spec/components/layout/carousel.md` exactly, with three spec syncs forced by the workspace's effect architecture.

### Files
- **New:** [crates/ars-components/src/layout/carousel/mod.rs](crates/ars-components/src/layout/carousel/mod.rs) — `State`/`Event`/`Effect`/`SlideAlignment`/`AutoPlayOptions`/`Context`/`Props`/`Messages`/`Machine`/`Part`(11)/`Api` + `ConnectApi` + 82 inline tests (2097 lines)
- **New:** 22 committed `.snap` fixtures under `…/carousel/snapshots/`
- **Modified:** [layout/mod.rs](crates/ars-components/src/layout/mod.rs) (module wiring), [tests/spec_conformance/layout.rs](crates/ars-components/tests/spec_conformance/layout.rs) (anatomy test), [tests/proptest_state_machines/layout.rs](crates/ars-components/tests/proptest_state_machines/layout.rs) (invariants proptest), [spec/components/layout/carousel.md](spec/components/layout/carousel.md) (spec sync)

### Spec synchronizations (landed in this PR)
1. **Timer effect** — spec called `set_interval`/`clear_interval` directly inside the machine (violates the agnostic contract; those don't exist in core). Replaced with a typed `Effect::AutoPlayTimer` marker emitted via `PendingEffect::named` / `cancel_effect`, matching the `toast::single::Effect` precedent.
2. **`initial_effects` override** — `init` boots into `AutoPlaying` but no `AutoPlayStart` fires on mount, so the timer would never arm. Added `initial_effects` emitting `AutoPlayTimer` when booting active (toast/popover/dialog pattern; adapters drain via `take_initial_effects()`).
3. **Imports + `Messages: PartialEq` + `SlideLabelFn` alias** — fixed `use crate::{Bindable,Duration}` (→ `ars_core::Bindable` + `core::time::Duration`), added `PartialEq` to `Messages` (required by `Context`'s derive), factored the 3-arg label closure into a type alias (clippy `type_complexity`).

### Audit findings (all landed)
- **Phase 1 — H1 (Medium):** `GoToSlide`/`FocusSlide` set a raw, unclamped index → out-of-range `current_index` would silently break every connect method. Added a saturating clamp to `[0, slide_count-1]` in impl + spec (with TDD tests; proptest broadened to feed out-of-range indices). **L1:** synced `map_or(false, …)` → `is_some_and` in the spec.
- **Phase 2 (2 clean rounds after):** renamed `autoplay_indicator_attrs` → `auto_play_indicator_attrs` for naming consistency (impl + spec); clarified `track_offset_percent` doc (axis extent for vertical). Adapter specs, manifest/catalog, foundation, deps all clean.
- **Phase 3:** added tests for `part_attrs` dispatch (the ConnectApi contract, previously untested), the GoToSlide-while-transitioning guard, GoToPrev `stop_on_interaction`, AutoPlayPause-when-idle, and AutoPlayResume-without-config.
